# DotOS v2.0.0

A big one. The watch firmware and the companion app now share a single version
number — install **DotOS Dashboard v2.0.0** on the phone alongside this.

## Flash
Open the one-click web flasher (link below) in Chrome or Edge and click **Install**,
or download the four `.bin` files and `DotOS-v2.0.0-flasher.html` from the assets.
Copy `dotos-v2.0.0-sdcard.zip` to the SD card root for the wallpapers and assets.

## What's new
- **HexHound, reimagined** — five 8-bit pixel-art creatures (Egg → Packet Pup →
  Beacon Beast → Gremlin → Sentinel), each with six moods, that wear the accent
  colour you pick in Face > Accent. Drawn entirely on the watch.
- **Music** — browse your SD library **by artist, album or track**, with tags read
  from the files (ID3 / FLAC). Long titles scroll iPod-style, there's a **volume
  slider** on the cassette, and a **Music tile** in the menu for one tap.
- **Calls** — a calm, repeating soft tap instead of a sustained buzz, a banner that
  stays up long enough to reach **Mute / Hang up**, and the ring stops when the call
  ends (answered elsewhere, e.g. Teams on a PC).

## Fixes
- **Much more internal RAM free** — ~80 KB of static tables moved to PSRAM, so the
  watch is steadier with Bluetooth and WiFi up.
- **Music no longer crashes or reports "no music"** on cards with files.
- **Settings sliders** no longer bounce you out of the page when you drag them.
- **No more non-stop vibration** — a chatty app (a live ChatGPT voice session) can't
  buzz the watch continuously; ordinary notifications are rate-limited, calls aren't.

Not every change is reflected in these notes; see the commit history for the full list.
